notes.title: Release Note
notes.notes:
Ver 1.1.0.0 - 2017/06/23

     Now able to display the video content to the desktop window, so your surrounding friend can watch it with you, too... (This is not a shared screen across internet, don't get confused)
     Allow user to adjust the position y.


Ver 1.0.6.0 - 2017/05/30

     Now you can use your downloaded background from SteamVR workshop.
     Fixed an audio track issue (After you play a youtube video, when you play a local file, the previous youtube video's audio track will be also played.)


Ver 1.0.4.1 - 2017/05/18

     Now support Youtube 1080p, 1440p videos.
     Add a dropdown list for user to select desired Youtube resolution.


Ver 1.0.4 - 2017/05/16

     Add support to more subtitle format: .srt, .ssa, .ass, .sub, .xml, 



Ver 1.0.3 - 2017/05/15

     Added eye swap feature to the 3D viewer (side by side & over under)
     Added a void scene (a pitch black environment)
     Added support for switching between multiple audio and subtitle tracks within the video files.
     Fixed bug that youtube search stops functional if the no result is found.
     Fixed issue with the virtual keyboard's Enter button.



Ver 1.0.2 - 2017/05/12

     Added support for 180 degree videos (of course stereo 3D supported, too)
     Fixed issue that the virtual keyboard does not show up and the Enter key does not function properly.
